parent.description:
Optional link to a parent {@link FlowGraph}. This field is intended to be populated when there exists
translation between {@link FlowGraph} and {@link WorkflowExecutionRepresentation}. It allows the execution metadata to
be aggregated to the original parent {@link FlowGraph}.

title: {@link ParallelSynchronousPyExecutionRepresentation} is the execution representation for the {@link ParallelSynchronousPyExecutor}.
name: ParallelSynchronousPyExecutionRepresentation
